obligations.statement: Listing with q keeps the topics whose title contains q, ignoring letter case, and reports their count as total.
Creating a topic without a string title answers 422 with error title_required.
A title is trimmed and its inner runs of whitespace become one space; outside 3 to 48 characters it is refused with 422, error title_length and the two bounds.
A title already in use, compared without letter case, is refused with 409, error title_taken and the id of the topic that holds it, on create and on rename.

A slug is the lower-cased title with every run of other characters replaced by one dash, cut to 24 characters and stripped of dashes at both ends; an empty result is topic; a slug in use gets -2, -3 and so on.
Renaming a topic changes its title and keeps the slug it was created with.
Reading a topic by id answers the topic, or 404 with error not_found.
The list shows pinned topics first, then the others, each group by ascending id.
Deleting a pinned topic is refused with 409 and error pinned; deleting another answers its id as deleted, and a second delete answers 404.
The add form refuses an empty title in the page without a request; otherwise it posts title and pinned, adds the new row to the list and reports Added with the stored title.
The about page describes the board and its pinned rule.
